name: Ontology
short_description: A formal set of shared definitions for a domain that specifies the types of things and the relationships that may connect them, so that people and systems interpret data the same way.

evidence.quote: Now the word ontology tends to make a useful conversation sound like it needs a philosophy degree.
A schema, an ontology, and a graph each do different work.
So that's where then the idea of nontology comes in.
The solution is what Microsoft calls fabric ontologies.
The ontology modeled every conceivable concept
